describes: packages/plugin/actions: the submit intent, resolver and sink chain.

cases.name: payload-less-submit-is-inert
cases.covers: An older-runtime SubmitForm with no payload is recognized-inert with its own diagnostic.

diagnostics.message: submit-form: payload unavailable (older runtime extraction) — node inert

cases.name: no-resolver
cases.covers: Without a dataset resolver every submit blocks with no-submit-resolver.

diagnostics.message: submit-form: no dataset resolver registered (form plugin missing?)

cases.name: resolver-failures
cases.covers: A resolver that throws or rejects fails the node with the dataset-resolution diagnostic.

diagnostics.message: submit-form: dataset resolution: field plane gone

cases.name: no-sink
cases.covers: With a resolver but no handler and no submit-capable home, the submit blocks with no-submit-sink.

diagnostics.message: submit-form: no handler installed and the document has no submit-capable home

cases.name: the-document-home
cases.covers: The home is awaited with the request shape it expects (charSet only when present, the clock for ISO sentAt); a refusal fails the node.

diagnostics.message: document home refused submit: permission denied: doc.forms.submit

cases.name: the-home-uses-the-configured-clock
cases.covers: ISO sentAt comes from javascript.now when configured, even with scripting disabled.

cases.name: a-handler-beats-the-home
cases.covers: An installed handler receives the request and a home delegate (or null without a home); synchronous acceptance executes and the home never auto-fires.
cases.reason: Pins the handoff between an installed submit handler and the home, through the handler callbacks and the engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: handler-contract
cases.covers: A synchronous throw fails the node; a returned promise is detached: resolving says nothing, rejecting emits a diagnostic later and never rewrites the node.

cases.name: submit-policy
cases.covers: A lifecycle submit is blocked by default; a policy row of allow or adapter admits it, and report or block refuse.

cases.name: submit-is-deferred-behind-document-work
cases.covers: A submit before a failing document node never fires.
